text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I run a good race, but what was with<n>Bright's
blindingly fast final spurt?! Is<n>that... the real power
of an<n>Umamusume family?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The race is barely over before Mejiro<n>Dober
comes up to me and declares<n>that she's going to
surpass me!<n>Defeat one challenger, and another
appears...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume families are a greater<n>force to be
reckoned with than I<n>thought! I have to find out
more about<n>the truth of their strength before the
Hanshin Juvenile Fillies!
